items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: One of the main things, I was supposed to be in the show, Eddy Bearfield. He says Cozy, what I want to do is get this show going on Broadway, get a big band, he said, and put all my friends to work

ctx.x: Yeah probably just sitting around all the music, all the dialogue, all the lyrics, everything, just laying there. One of the main things, I was supposed to be in the show, Eddy Bearfield. He says Cozy, what I want to do is get this show going on Broadway, get a big band, he said, and put all my friends to work and let it run. It would have been, the way, I read the whole score, it would have been a Tobacco Road, that kind of show, see and it was the truth in it, way back there, Uncle Tom's Cabin. The name of it…
